introduction: Welcome to the Plains of Life. Follow the signs to learn the basics before entering the world.
orientation: Use look sign when you find a tutorial sign, and use help newbie and help equipment.
Follow the signs and meet the people along the path. Their guidance appears here after you see them.

contacts.name: a solemn paladin
contacts.description: Ask about racewars to finish the introduction. Then use enter stream at the Stream of Life to travel to Ailvio. This tutorial conversation does not award a tracked item-delivery achievement.
